description: All new AI use cases require sign-off from the AI Governance Committee before development begins, with senior leadership accountable for approval.
Model performance metrics including accuracy and drift are tracked monthly and reviewed against agreed thresholds.
Application logs capture key system events for AI-enabled tools to support traceability and post-incident review.
Third-party AI vendors undergo a security and data handling questionnaire prior to onboarding.
A documented AI policy exists and is reviewed annually by the risk committee.
Data used to train or fine-tune models is reviewed for quality and completeness prior to use.
Users of AI-enabled decision tools can escalate or override outputs they believe are incorrect.
An internal audit function periodically reviews AI systems for conformance with internal policy.
Incident response procedures include a specific playbook for AI system failures or anomalous outputs.
Staff working on AI systems complete mandatory annual training on responsible AI use.
